content: NestJS JWT best practice for a dedicated staff/admin auth table: short-lived access tokens (15min-1hr) + separate refresh token, refresh token hashed at rest (plaintext refresh-token DB leak = account takeover), rotate refresh token on each use, invalidate on logout. Use Passport JWT strategy + Nest Guards; role-based restriction via @Roles decorator + RolesGuard for admin-only endpoints. Sessions (stateful, easy revoke) vs JWT (stateless, scales) is a real tradeoff -- for an internal low-traffic staff app, either works, but JWT+refresh is what the project's PROJECT.md already commits to.
